Minion A is blocked. Minion C plays hidden lurker to jump the
blocker. Can Minion C play a freak drive when this is done? At
inferior superior or both?

T

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
<Talo...@nospam.hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:3c6db618.60009112@news...

>
> Minion A is blocked. Minion C plays hidden lurker to jump the
> blocker. Can Minion C play a freak drive when this is done? At
> inferior superior or both?

Certainly not. Minion C entered combat (and tapped) via Hidden Lurker. He
has in *no way* completed an action, which is required for playing freak
drive.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Also note that he is not an acting minion, so cannot play action
modifiers in the first place (unless card text allows it).
